license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization, or a combination of any of them, to engage in the business of, submit a bid or respond to a request for qualification or a request for proposals for construction services as, act or offer to act in the capacity of or purport to have the capacity of a contractor without having a contractor's license in good standing

issuing_authority.quote: A contractor's license may be issued only by act of the registrar of contractors.

name.quote: A contractor's license may be issued only by act of the registrar of contractors.

type.quote: The governor shall appoint a registrar of contractors pursuant to section 38-211. The registrar shall serve at the pleasure of the governor. The registrar is vested with all functions and duties relating to administration of this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: A license may not be issued to a minor, to any partnership in which one of the partners is a minor or to any corporation in which a corporate officer is a minor.

moral_character_required.quote: each person who is named on a license must not have engaged in contracting without a license or committed any act that, if committed or done by any licensed contractor, would be grounds for suspension or revocation of a contractor's license

degree_required.value: Technical training in an accredited college or university or in a manufacturer's accredited training program may be substituted for a portion of such experience
degree_required.quote: Technical training in an accredited college or university or in a manufacturer's accredited training program may be substituted for a portion of such experience, but in no case may credited technical training exceed two years of the required four years' experience.

degree_level.quote: Have a minimum of four years' practical or management trade experience, at least two of which must have been within the last ten years, dealing specifically with the type of construction, or its equivalent, for which the applicant is applying for a license.

exams.notes: The registrar shall waive the examination requirement if the qualifying party is currently or has previously been a qualifying party in the same classification within the preceding five years.
exams.quote: Successfully show, by written examination taken not more than two years before application, if required, qualification in the kind of work for which the applicant proposes to contract, the applicant's general knowledge of the building, safety, health and lien laws of the state, administrative principles of the contracting business and the rules adopted by the registrar of contractors

title_protection.quote: it is a class 1 misdemeanor for any person to advertise that the person is able to perform any service or contract for compensation subject to regulation by the registrar under the terms of this chapter unless the person first obtains a license under the terms of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a contract or refusal to perform after submitting a bid without legal excuse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a contract or refusal to perform after submitting a bid on work without legal excuse for the abandonment or refusal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or disregard of plans, specifications, or building codes in a material respect prejudicial to another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Departure from or disregard of: (a) Plans or specifications in any material respect that is prejudicial to another without consent of the owner ... (b) A building code of this state or any political subdivision of this state in any material respect that is prejudicial to another.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule adopted by the registrar.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule adopted by the registrar.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with statutes or rules governing social security, workers' compensation, or unemployment insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the statutes or rules governing social security, workers' compensation or unemployment insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of a material fact by the applicant in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of a material fact by the applicant in obtaining a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor resulting in substantial injury to another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The doing of a fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor resulting in another person being substantially injured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in a material respect to complete a construction project for the price stated in the contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect by the licensee to complete a construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract, or in any modification of the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to evade this chapter by aiding, abetting, acting with, or allowing one's license to be used by others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to evade this chapter by: (a) Aiding or abetting a licensed or unlicensed person. (b) Acting or conspiring with a licensed or unlicensed person. (c) Allowing one's license to be used by a licensed or unlicensed person. (d) Acting as agent, partner, associate or otherwise of a licensed or unlicensed person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay monies in excess of $750 when due for materials or services rendered in connection with the licensee's operations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or agent or official of a licensee to pay monies in excess of $750 when due for materials or services rendered in connection with the licensee's operations as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a contractor to comply with any safety or labor laws or codes of federal, state, or local government.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a contractor to comply with any safety or labor laws or codes of the federal government, this state or political subdivisions of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in any material respect to comply with this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in any material respect to comply with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor for work requiring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly entering into a contract with a contractor for work to be performed for which a license is required with a person that is not duly licensed in the required classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license in a name other than as set forth on the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued under this chapter in a name other than as set forth on the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False, misleading, or deceptive advertising whereby any member of the public was misled and injured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False, misleading or deceptive advertising whereby any member of the public was misled and injured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly contracting beyond the scope of the licensee's license(s).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly contracting beyond the scope of the license or licenses of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting, offering to contract, or submitting a bid while the license is under suspension or on inactive status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting or offering to contract or submitting a bid while the license is under suspension or while the license is on inactive status.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the registrar within fifteen days of disassociation of the qualifying party, or failure to obtain a new qualifying party within sixty days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to notify the registrar in writing within a period of fifteen days of any disassociation of the person who qualified for the license. The licensee must qualify through another person within sixty days after the date of disassociation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subsequent discovery of facts that, if known at the time of license issuance or renewal, would have been grounds for denial.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subsequent discovery of facts that if known at the time of issuance of a license or the renewal of a license would have been grounds to deny the issuance or renewal of the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a person named on the license who is or was named on any other license in this state or another state that is under suspension or revocation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a person named on the license who is or was named on any other license in this state or in another state that is under suspension or revocation for any act or omission that occurs while the person is or was named on the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing a new single-family residential construction project with actual knowledge that required pretreatment for wood-destroying pests was not performed or was performed inconsistently with requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing a new single-family residential construction project with actual knowledge that a pretreatment wood-destroying pests or organisms application was either: (a) Not performed at the required location. (b) Performed in a manner inconsistent with label requirements, state law or rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to take appropriate corrective action to comply with this chapter or rules within a reasonable period after receiving a written directive from the registrar.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to take appropriate corrective action to comply with this chapter or with rules adopted pursuant to this chapter without valid justification within a reasonable period of time after receiving a written directive from the registrar.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prohibiting, threatening, retaliating against, or intimidating any contractor or materialman from serving a preliminary lien notice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prohibit, threaten to prohibit, retaliate against, threaten to retaliate against or otherwise intimidate any contractor or materialman from serving a preliminary notice pursuant to section 33-992.01.

bonding_required.quote: Before granting an original contractor's license, the registrar shall require of the applicant a surety bond in a form acceptable to the registrar or a cash deposit as provided in this section. No contractor's license may be renewed unless the applicant's surety bond or cash deposit is in full force and effect.

insurance_required.quote: the attestation must contain the workers' compensation insurance policy number or be accompanied by proof of self-insurance.

definition_quote.value: Contractor means any person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization, or a combination of any of them, that, for compensation, undertakes to or offers to undertake to, purports to have the capacity to undertake to, submits a bid or responds to a request for qualification or a request for proposals for construction services to, does himself or by or through others, or directly or indirectly supervises others to: (i) Construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building ... (ii) Connect such a structure or improvements to utility service lines and metering devices and the sewer line. (iii) Provide mechanical or structural service for any such structure or improvements.
